      Pooh Shiesty and his father have reportedly been arrested following a raid on their family home in Tennessee. On Thursday (April 2), TMZ broke the news that the Memphis rapper, born Lontell Williams Jr., was taken into custody by authorities in Dallas. News of the arrests comes after search and arrest warrants were executed on a home in Cordova, Tenn., owned by Pooh or his father. Rumors have circulated that the raid and arrests have something to do with a robbery involving Gucci Mane earlier this year. 50 Cent weighed in on the news on Thursday.
